newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER - CLUB BRUGGE SECURE 2-0 CUSHION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - CLUB BRUGGE SECURE 2-0 CUSHION.

text.p: Belgian champions Club Brugge produced a dazzling first-half performance on their way to a 2-0 win over National Bucharest in their UEFA Cup second round, first leg match on Tuesday.
Brugge dominated from the start, Croatian striker Robert Spehar forcing goalkeeper Razvan Lucescu to turn his header against the bar in the first minute.
But Brugge were not to be denied for long. In the 10th minute Gert Verheyen slipped the ball between two defenders beyond the reach of Lucescu after cutting in from the edge of the penalty area.
Belgian international midfielder Lorenzo Staelens beat Lucescu again in the 39th minute with a scorching close-range effort.
Brugge, playing in the UEFA Cup after losing to another Bucharest club, Steaua, in the qualifying round of the European Cup in August, created several other chances in the first half.
But they tended to sit on their lead after the break.
"We overwhelmed Bucharest in the first half, they didn't exist, but we came to a standstill in the second half and that's how they survived," Brugge coach Hugo Broos said.
